note: Thresholds are provisional (plan § 1). Each control runs with its options as listed and again reversed; a control passes only when every order passes. The wording-swap control asks the same state under the question set's own intent wording and under neutral_intent below.
neutral_intent: You control a vehicle in a stage of a video game. Each listed option is an action available right now, with what it involves. Choose the single intent to hold for the next second or two.

controls.rationale: A cache that costs nothing and takes no time to open is a free permanent buff. An instrument that declines it is measuring its own wording.

options.why: You are already rolling over the cache. Opening it costs 0 scrap and no stopping time; it grants one random permanent stacking buff (+10% cruise, +1 m/s jump, -15% boost cooldown, +25% impact damage, or +20 max HP)
Skip it and keep driving for the forge apron
Detour onto the nearest scrap line and bank more scrap

controls.rationale: At 8 HP a ram that deals 25 contact damage to the player ends the run. The ram is executable (fast tier), so only judgement keeps it from being chosen.

options.why: You are above the fast tier and the chaser sits directly on the current line; ramming it deals 25 contact damage to you
Break contact entirely; health regenerates 5 s after the last hit
Steer around the chaser and keep the line

controls.rationale: A modest cache early in the run with no threats. The state carries the decision, so the choice should not depend on how the intent question is worded.

options.why: You are already rolling over the cache. Opening it costs 25 of the 140 scrap held and about one second of stopping; it grants one random permanent stacking buff
Skip it and keep driving for the forge apron
More scrap lies along the siding ahead
